features.title: Rear ENTER and button-to-section glass transition
features.user_visible_behavior: Panels fade before rear ENTER appears. Activation evaporates ENTER and launches six glass letter/buttons with fluid trails. The first unfolds into the restored top menu; the second expands into a wide empty information block while retaining its top-left icon. Four controls stay at the bottom; background cursor interaction starts after final settling.
acceptance_criteria: Remove all audio functionality and controls.
Wait for window load, fonts and the background first frame; finish at least one complete loader cycle and all delayed lines before assembly.
Panels translate from upper-left with staggered cubic braking; keep labyla visible through assembly.
After assembly, fade panel illumination all the way to zero over 1.2s, with no 50% stop and no activation dependency.

Keep original-size labyla as foreground geometry; render a separate ENTER behind it at 112% of wordmark bounds, in the existing animated cyan/deep-teal gradient. Reveal ENTER over 1.1s only after the panel fade reaches zero, with smooth coverage and a filtered contour glow.

Illuminated gradient regions of rear ENTER have contour glow in idle and hover states. Only rear ENTER enlarges on hover/focus and gains a bright diffuse cyan glow. Native entry hit bounds follow it; retain keyboard focus and guarded activation.
Include rear ENTER in background/refraction sampling so it remains behind the glass letters; keep responsive horizontal/vertical composition without overflow.
On activation, evaporate rear ENTER over 0.55s using upward drift, softening and fade, while immediately starting the six labyla letter flights. No reverse text morph or preflight delay remains.
Letters depart last-to-first, 100ms apart, from measured glyph contours and fixed origins; retain right/down/left arcs, compact lenses and late opening.

Keep 2.1s flights for the four centered bottom controls. Extend the first two flights to 3.2s; unfold them over 0.85s into the restored top menu and an empty information block below it. Retain the second icon at its top-left arrival position and fade the first icon during menu unfolding. Keep 0.4s final settling.
Preserve small matte glass controls, smaller muted-gray visual placeholder icons and weak diffuse glow; do not invent navigation destinations.
Fit all controls with resting side clearance at least 16px and bottom clearance 24px; retain one canvas and viewport-sized desktop/mobile pages.

During flight, six independent button positions and velocities drive the existing fluid brush. Enable cursor injection and autonomous flute drift only after all flights plus final settling (4.55s after activation). Track inactive cursor positions and let button trails advect/decay after landing; preserve inactive pink/purple Prisma components.

Menu: up to 720x56px, 22px corners, 20px top gap. Information block: up to 960x420px starting at 104px from top; shrink to fit above bottom controls on mobile and short screens. Leave both empty pending content decisions.
